Examples

A selection of work I’ve designed and built end-to-end. Each one reflects a problem I wanted to solve and the craft that went into making it feel effortless to use.

FigletTool

A browser-based IDE for Figma plugins, write and run plugin code instantly, no local setup. Like CodePen for Figma.

AskerooLibrary

A modern CLI prompt library with stateful back-navigation, conditional fields and task runners. Built on React and Ink.

Table CreatorPlugin

A Figma plugin for creating and maintaining complex data tables on the canvas, with dynamic content and bulk edits.

Icon PreviewPlugin

A Figma plugin that live-previews the icon you are editing at preset sizes for web, iOS and Android.

Layer StylesPlugin

A Figma plugin for saving and applying style presets, strokes, fills, corner radius, effects, padding, grids, opacity and blend modes.

Staging

Askeroo

The first stateful CLI that allows back navigation. I created Askeroo after wishing more from the prompt wizards that were avaiable. I wanted something modular and configurable for different needs.

Highly configurable default prompts
Create your own prompts using the Ink library
Built-in task runners for long-running steps
JavaScript
// Your flow function runs multiple times
const flow = async () => {
  const role = await radio({
      label: "Select your role",
      options: ["Developer", "Designer"],
  });

  if (role === "Developer") {
    const language = await radio({
        label: "Preferred language",
        options: ["TypeScript", "JavaScript"],
    });
    return { role, language };
  }

  const tool = await radio({
      label: "Design tool",
      options: ["Figma", "Sketch"],
  });
  return { role, tool };
};
JavaScript
const flow = async () => {
  const name = await text({
      message: "Name",
  });
  return { name };
}

const result = await ask(flow);

A flow is simply an object made up of prompts. Run these prompts by calling the object with ask().

bash
Features

You can make prompts conditional by guarding them with conditions. In this example, the "Preferred language" prompt will only get shown if the "Developer" role is chosen.

Creating a flow
Stateful back-navigation, revise earlier answers at any time
Conditional prompts
Conditional fields that respond to prior input
Customise flow by creating groups and nested groups
